pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Do not claim saved customer context without proof
lesson.when: A customer asks if previous context, message history, or prior questions are saved
lesson.do: Verify conversation history via official system data or sources before confirming past details
lesson.otherwise: State that you do not have the verified information available to confirm previous details
